propositions: Current clarity measure duplicates logic across two files and rewards volume/legacy shape rather than author-guide contract compliance, allowing padded tickets without required sections.

Clarity scoring lacks deterministic checks for required section structure keyed to graph altitude (leaf vs. container), per-AC verification coverage, placeholder language, grounded edit-sets, and testing shape markers.
Author guide and plan-review criteria contain unresolved conflicts: Success Criteria vs. Acceptance Criteria terminology and rejected-alternative requirement vs. positive-rationale-only guidance.
Recommended deterministic additions must avoid semantic/persona judgment and reuse existing fields (file_impact) to prevent scorer drift and enable per-check evidence reporting.
